svg.text: OP-100 assembly order (exploded, step 1 at the bottom, lid and gaskets last; dock parts from below)
1 housing lifts +0 mm in the picture
2 tank + plunger + rod cartridge lifts +9 mm in the picture
3 motor + gear A lifts +18 mm in the picture
4 battery (301030) lifts +26 mm in the picture
5 board + USB-C (PCBA with SW1, LED, sounder; motor 4 + cell 2 wires soldered to its west-end pads first) lifts +34 mm in the picture
6 seal ring + USB-C frame + lid (button cap + O-ring pre-fitted in the lid) + 3 screws lifts +44 mm in the picture
7 dock parts from BELOW through the pocket (springs: tabs pushed up into the anchor slots) lifts -12 mm in the picture
